# Mistral AI Dart Client

> Dart client for the Mistral AI API with chat completions, streaming, tool calling, multimodal inputs, TTS, voice management, reasoning effort, embeddings, OCR, and more.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/README.md): Primary package documentation with installation, configuration, and usage examples.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/CHANGELOG.md): Release history and version-by-version changes.
- [MIGRATION](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/MIGRATION.md): Upgrade notes and breaking-change guidance.

## Examples

- [chat_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/chat_example.dart): How do I use chat completions?
- [streaming_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/streaming_example.dart): How do I stream responses?
- [vision_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/vision_example.dart): How do I use vision?
- [tool_calling_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/tool_calling_example.dart): How do I use tool calling?
- [json_mode_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/json_mode_example.dart): How do I use structured output?
- [embeddings_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/embeddings_example.dart): How do I create embeddings?
- [fim_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/fim_example.dart): How do I use code completions?
- [files_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/files_example.dart): How do I manage files?
- [fine_tuning_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/fine_tuning_example.dart): How do I fine-tune and batch?
- [moderation_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/moderation_example.dart): How do I moderate content?
- [ocr_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/ocr_example.dart): How do I extract text from documents?
- [audio_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/audio_example.dart): How do I use audio?
- [agents_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/agents_example.dart): How do I use agents?
- [conversations_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/conversations_example.dart): How do I use conversations?
- [libraries_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/libraries_example.dart): How do I use libraries?
- [error_handling_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/error_handling_example.dart): Error Handling.
- [batch_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/batch_example.dart): Batch processing.
- [classification_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/classification_example.dart): Text classification.
- [models_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/models_example.dart): Model listing.
- [config_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/config_example.dart): Client configuration options.
- [multi_turn_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/multi_turn_example.dart): Multi-turn conversation management.
- [parallel_requests_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/parallel_requests_example.dart): Parallel and concurrent requests.
- [rag_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/rag_example.dart): Retrieval Augmented Generation.
- [semantic_search_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/semantic_search_example.dart): Semantic search with embeddings.
- [system_message_example.dart](https://github.com/davidmigloz/ai_clients_dart/blob/main/packages/mistralai_dart/example/system_message_example.dart): System message patterns.
